classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Page 49 union membership joins the overlapping sets; page 44 determines the excluded finite endpoint and round bracket at infinity.

content.prompt:
Simplify the following sets and write the result as a single interval.
$$(1,\infty)\cup(-5,5]$$

answer.worked:
The intervals overlap on $(1,5]$ and together contain every real number greater than $-5$. The endpoint $-5$ is excluded.
$$(1,\infty)\cup(-5,5]=(-5,\infty).$$
